entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Preorders Unlock a Mobile Weapon Blueprint
entries.summary: Xbox Wire says preordering Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 grants the Shattered Relay weapon blueprint in Call of Duty: Mobile.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by Xbox Wire at 10-13 02:17 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Kegaretsuki no Shoujo: Narumi Tatsuya no Kaikiroku Announced for PC
entries.summary: BogeymanGames announced a first-person exploration horror sequel planned for PC via Steam in 2028.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10-13 09:25 Beijing time.

entries.headline: ARC Raiders Returns to 180,000 Concurrent Steam Players After Major Update
entries.summary: ARC Raiders reached about 180,000 concurrent Steam players after its October 8 Frozen Trail update, with a one-week PvE matchmaking beta due to begin October 13.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10-12 15:39 Beijing time.

entries.headline: He-Man: Dragon Pearl of Destruction Launches February 4, 2027
entries.summary: The retro brawler launches February 4, 2027 for Nintendo Switch, PS5, and Xbox Series, with physical editions also planned.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN Games at 10-12 21:40 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Incremental Management Game Fill the Sea Announced for PC
entries.summary: One Bucket Studio announced Fill the Sea, an incremental PC game about rebuilding an ocean through workers and automation. No release date was given.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10-12 13:08 Beijing time.

entries.headline: RimWorld 1.7 Moves to Waylith Engine With Claimed 2–4× Performance Gains
entries.summary: Ludeon Studios announced RimWorld 1.7, migrating the PC game from Unity to its in-house Waylith Engine. The unstable Steam branch is available now.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10-13 08:29 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Drawing-Based Tower Defense Game Marukaite Dokan Announced for PC
entries.summary: Solo developer soyukke announced a 2–8 player PC tower-defense game where drawn shapes become defensive tools. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10-12 16:23 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Risk of Rain 2 DLC Pushes Steam Concurrency to 46,000
entries.summary: Risk of Rain 2 reached roughly 46,000 concurrent Steam players after 2K Games released its fourth DLC, Hallowed Concepts, on October 9.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10-13 08:57 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Hunter's Moon Reveals Its Voice Cast Ahead of PS5 Launch
entries.summary: Twin Swans announced the full voice cast for its first-person historical folk-horror game, due for PS5 on October 26.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by Gematsu at 10-12 21:24 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Usual June Delayed to January 20, 2027
entries.summary: Finji delayed the PC action-adventure game from October 28 to January 20, 2027.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by Gematsu at 10-13 03:12 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day Developer Confirms DDoS Attack
entries.summary: The Coalition said intermittent disconnects and login problems were caused by a DDoS attack targeting the game's online services.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN Games at 10-12 17:33 Beijing time.

entries.headline: IGN Review Says Gears of War: E-Day Preserves the Series' Emotional Core
entries.summary: IGN's review argues that the prequel balances strong combat with meaningful character work for Marcus, Dom, and their new squadmates.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN Games at 10-13 03:00 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Silver Pines Reaches 94% Positive Steam Reviews
entries.summary: Team17 released Silver Pines for PC on October 9; AUTOMATON reported a 94% positive Steam user-review score at publication time.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10-12 17:05 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Nintendo Latin America Executive Says Physical Media Is Not Being Discontinued
entries.summary: Bill van Zyll said Nintendo currently has no plan to stop offering physical game media, while acknowledging the added cost of physical products.
entries.verification: The opened packet source supports the stated subject, facts, and timing.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 10-12 14:28 Beijing time.
